command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $ssh=(Get-Command ssh -ErrorAction Stop).Source; $alias='shopvivaliz-vm'; $remote=@'
set -Eeuo pipefail
cd /home/ubuntu/mei-mg-email
echo CHECK_BRT=$(TZ=America/Sao_Paulo date +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z)
if sudo test -f /var/lib/mei-mg-email/sender_blocked.pause; then echo SENTINEL=present; sudo systemctl stop mei-mg-email-worker.service || true; exit 52; fi
echo SENTINEL=absent
sent_before=$(sudo docker exec mei-mg-email-db psql -U postgres -d mei_mg_email -At -c "select count(*) from mei_email.envios where status::text in ('submitted','enviado') and enviado_em>=now()-interval '24 hours';")
pending_before=$(sudo docker exec mei-mg-email-db psql -U postgres -d mei_mg_email -At -c "select count(*) from mei_email.envios where status::text in ('pendente','pending','enviando','processing');")
echo SENT24_BEFORE=$sent_before
echo PENDING_BEFORE=$pending_before
if [ "$sent_before" -ge 9950 ]; then echo TARGET_ALREADY_REACHED=true; exit 0; fi
git fetch origin main >/dev/null 2>&1
git checkout origin/main -- worker/safe_entrypoint.py
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('app/queue_manager.py')
s=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
s=s.replace("                       'user_explicit_authorization_2026-08-20',\n", '')
s=s.replace("                       \"user_explicit_authorization_2026-08-20\",\n", '')
p.write_text(s, encoding='utf-8')
PY
.venv/bin/python -m py_compile worker/safe_entrypoint.py worker/safe_entrypoint_v2.py app/queue_manager.py
if [ "$pending_before" -lt 300 ]; then
  set +e
  timeout 100s .venv/bin/python -u - <<'PY'
import psycopg
from app.config import settings
from app.queue_manager import repor_fila_automatica
with psycopg.connect(settings.database_url) as conn:
    print('AUTOQUEUE_ADDED='+str(repor_fila_automatica(conn)), flush=True)
PY
  echo AUTOQUEUE_RC=$?
  set -e
else
  echo AUTOQUEUE_SKIPPED=pending_sufficient
fi
sudo systemctl reset-failed mei-mg-email-worker.service || true
sudo systemctl restart mei-mg-email-worker.service
sleep 65
worker=$(sudo systemctl is-active mei-mg-email-worker.service 2>/dev/null || true)
enabled=$(sudo systemctl is-enabled mei-mg-email-worker.service 2>/dev/null || true)
timer=$(sudo systemctl is-active mei-mg-email-autorepair.timer 2>/dev/null || true)
sentinel=$(sudo test -f /var/lib/mei-mg-email/sender_blocked.pause && echo present || echo absent)
sent_after=$(sudo docker exec mei-mg-email-db psql -U postgres -d mei_mg_email -At -c "select count(*) from mei_email.envios where status::text in ('submitted','enviado') and enviado_em>=now()-interval '24 hours';")
sent15=$(sudo docker exec mei-mg-email-db psql -U postgres -d mei_mg_email -At -c "select count(*) from mei_email.envios where status::text in ('submitted','enviado') and enviado_em>=now()-interval '15 minutes';")
pending_after=$(sudo docker exec mei-mg-email-db psql -U postgres -d mei_mg_email -At -c "select count(*) from mei_email.envios where status::text in ('pendente','pending','enviando','processing');")
latest=$(sudo docker exec mei-mg-email-db psql -U postgres -d mei_mg_email -At -c "select coalesce(max(enviado_em)::text,'none') from mei_email.envios where status::text in ('submitted','enviado');")
asn=$(sudo journalctl -u mei-mg-email-worker.service --since '-15 minutes' --no-pager | grep -Eic 'AS\(42004\)|bad outbound sender|5\.1\.8' || true)
echo WORKER=$worker
echo WORKER_ENABLED=$enabled
echo AUTOREPAIR_TIMER=$timer
echo SENTINEL_AFTER=$sentinel
echo SENT24_AFTER=$sent_after
echo SENT15=$sent15
echo PENDING_AFTER=$pending_after
echo LATEST=$latest
echo AS42004_LAST15M=$asn
echo PROGRESS=$((sent_after-sent_before))
if [ "$asn" -gt 0 ]; then sudo touch /var/lib/mei-mg-email/sender_blocked.pause; sudo systemctl stop mei-mg-email-worker.service || true; echo FAIL_CLOSED=AS42004; exit 53; fi
'@; $out=& $ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=15 $alias $remote 2>$null; $rc=$LASTEXITCODE; $repo='C:\site-shopvivaliz'; $report=Join-Path $repo 'reports\fredwin-email-live-20260820-1200.txt'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path (Split-Path $report) | Out-Null; $out | Set-Content -Encoding UTF8 $report; Push-Location $repo; try { git add -- 'reports/fredwin-email-live-20260820-1200.txt'; if(-not (git diff --cached --quiet)){ git commit -m 'ops: record Fred-Win live email sender state'; git push origin HEAD:main } } finally { Pop-Location }; $out | ForEach-Object {Write-Output $_}; if($rc -ne 0){throw ('remote sender command failed rc='+$rc)}
reason: Continue production email sending through the validated Fred-Win SSH alias and persist a sanitized operational report
